name: raycash
title: RayCash
description: Menu bar balances and recent transactions across your linked financial institutions, via SimpleFIN Bridge.
author: zeev

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Set Up SimpleFIN
commands.description: Claim a SimpleFIN setup token and get your Access URL, without using a terminal.

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.description: Balances and recent transactions in the macOS menu bar.

commands.name: accounts
commands.title: Accounts
commands.description: Dynamically rename, hide, or exclude accounts from your net worth.

commands.name: transactions
commands.title: Transactions
commands.description: View a tabular list of recent transactions across all accounts.

commands.name: refresh
commands.title: Refresh Balances
commands.description: Force a refresh of RayCash balances.

preferences.name: accessUrl
preferences.title: SimpleFIN Access URL
preferences.description: Paste the URL from the Set Up SimpleFIN command. Stored encrypted by Raycast.

preferences.name: prefArchiveDays
preferences.title: Local Archive Limit (Days)
preferences.description: How many days of historical transactions to keep in local cache. Leave blank for 365.

preferences.name: prefAccountTxn
preferences.title: Transactions Per Account
preferences.description: How many recent transactions to list inside each account submenu. Leave blank for 8.

preferences.name: prefGlobalTxnCount
preferences.title: Global Transactions Count
preferences.description: How many recent transactions to show in the combined list at the bottom. Leave blank for 15, or 0 for none.

preferences.name: prefGlobalTxnDays
preferences.title: Global Transactions Days
preferences.description: Show all transactions from the last X days in the combined list. Leave blank for 7.

preferences.name: prefTitleMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What to display next to the icon in the menu bar.

preferences.name: prefGroupByDate
preferences.title: Grouping
preferences.label: Group transactions by date
preferences.description: Off shows one flat list with the date on each row, divided where the day changes. On collapses each earlier day into its own submenu and leaves today expanded.

preferences.name: prefRowTemplate
preferences.title: Row Template
preferences.description: What each transaction row shows. Tokens: {date} {amount} {payee} {payee_raw} {description} {memo} {account} {posted} {pending} {id}. Text between tokens is literal, and an empty token takes its punctuation with it. {date} uses the Day Heading Format unless you give it one, e.g. {date:EEE MMM d}. {account} is dropped inside an account submenu. Leave blank for {date} • {amount} • {payee} ({account})

preferences.name: prefDisableAlignment
preferences.title: Alignment
preferences.label: Disable pseudo alignment
preferences.description: Amounts and dates are padded with width-matched Unicode spaces so they line up in a column, since the menu font's digits are proportional. Check this to leave them unpadded — useful if the padding copies badly into another app or renders oddly at your font size.

preferences.name: prefDateFormat
preferences.title: Day Heading Format
preferences.description: ICU pattern for the day headings when grouping is on: yyyy MM dd EEE MMMM. Note dd is day-of-month, not DD. Today and Yesterday are always named. Leave blank for MM-dd.

preferences.name: prefDefaultCurrency
preferences.title: Hide Currency Symbol / Code
preferences.description: Enter a symbol or code to strip from amounts (e.g., '$', 'USD', '€'). Leave blank to show currency on all amounts.

preferences.name: prefPositiveColor
preferences.title: Positive / Income Color
preferences.description: Hex (e.g. 2ECC71, #0f0) or HTML color (lime, blueviolet). Leave blank for #0f0.

preferences.name: prefNegativeColor
preferences.title: Negative / Expense Color
preferences.description: Hex (e.g. E74C3C, #f00) or HTML color (red, tomato). Leave blank for #f00.

preferences.name: minIntervalMinutes
preferences.title: Minimum Fetch Interval (Minutes)
preferences.description: Hard floor between network requests. SimpleFIN suggests ~90 mins. Leave blank for 90.
